reference.title: BacnetVirtualObject (bacnet-BacnetVirtualObject)
reference.shortdesc: This component represents the driver implementation of a Baja virtual point, where each BacnetVirtualObject corresponds to a BACnet object. BacnetVirtualObjects can provide basic monitor access in Px views and be used for one-off read/write access to configuration properties.

section.p: Virtual objects reside in the station’s virtual component space, and are not persisted in the station’s database in its component space (Config), like regular components. You find them by expanding the Property Sheet of the Virtual node (BacnetVirtualGateway) under each BacnetDevice and BacnetWsDevice. The Property Sheet of each BacnetVirtualObject provides dynamic property values for the object.
